notes: A launch that finds the playlist list missing now restores it from the copy SideCut keeps on your device before anything else is written, so the backup can no longer be overwritten by the very launch that needed it.
When only the playlist list is gone, with songs, albums and settings intact, just that list is put back and nothing else you have is changed.
If the backup holds no copy of the list, the app now changes nothing and says nothing, instead of reporting a recovery it did not make.
Your songs, playlists and saved lyrics stay on your device — nothing in your library is removed by this release.
